item.title: Mahou Bishoujo Magical ☆ Moerin ♪ S
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rainbow Cyc
  • 発売日: 2012-02-10
  • スコア: 6.85/10 (24 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 魔法美少女まじかる☆萌えりん♪S
  • 英語名: Mahou Bishoujo Magical ☆ Moerin ♪ S

あらすじ

Masaharu spends noisy days together with his imouto who’s a little lacking in morals. On his way home from school one day, he came upon a mahou shoujo surrounded by people in black tights who could easily be mistaken for perverts. He recognized her as his osananajimi who had left a year ago. The next day, the bad guys turned to attack him and other mahou shoujos showed up to fight them. Will they be able to protect him?

item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Rainbow Cyc
  • 発売日: 2009-08-21
  • スコア: なし (4 人評価)
  • 日本語名: まじかる☆萌えりん♪
  • 英語名: Magical☆Moerin♪

あらすじ

Moeyama Moeko is approached by a stranger and asked to become a magical girl. She agrees without hesitation and is prepared to fight monsters for love and justice. She then becomes Magical Moerin. She should have asked questions first however because it seems her purpose as Magical Moerin is to provide sexual relief to strangers.
